notes.title: Update Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Entasy Online 0.2.0 Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Refreshed settings design.
[*] Added 3 creature types: Archer, Mage, Warrior
[*] Added use quick item shortcut buttons.
[*] Added target nearest enemy setting.
[*] Recoded object management system.
[*] Increased max level to 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.0
notes.content:
[p]Entasy Online 0.1.0 Release Notes: [/p][list][*][p] First release of the refreshed game on Steam. [/p][/*][*][p] Added 4 skills: Fire Wrath, Arcane Seal, Swift Wings, Void Blossom[/p][/*][*][p] Added new settings: Hide skill buttons, hide all mobile buttons.
 [/p][/*][/list][p]View all release notes: [url="https://www.entasyonline.com/wiki/release-notes"]https://www.entasyonline.com/wiki/release-notes[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Please note that game is still in early access and accounts may be removed later.[/p]

notes.title: Update Version 0.0.99
notes.content:
Entasy Online 0.0.99 Release Notes:
[list]
[*] Added x and y coordinates to the minimap.
[*] Added request to delete account button to the main menu.
[*] Changed main menu theme to the summer.
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 0.0.98
notes.content:
Entasy Online 0.0.98 Release Notes:
[list]
[*] Optimization improvements.
[*] Changed design of amethyst equipments.
[*] Music setting now changes the volume of music in the main menu as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 0.0.95
notes.content:
Entasy Online 0.0.95 Release Notes:
[list]
[*] Changed max health.
[*] Changed some items.
[*] Changed item drop rates.
[*] Changed craft anvil location.
[*] Updated button locations (Windows).
[*] Updated chat location (Windows).
[*] Added npcs as orange dots to minimap.
[*] There is no more prompt when putting/taking only 1 item to/from storage.
[*] Nerfed melee damage.
[*] Fixed creature walking system.
[*] Fixed obelisk stone in spawn area.
[/list]
